physical: Virtual particles and the range of a force — A force carried by exchange of a virtual particle has a range of about the reduced Planck constant over the mediator's mass times c: the heavier the mediator, the shorter the reach. Formula: r ≈ ħ ÷ (m × c)
reflected_formula: Vibration ≈ (a constant with no partner) ÷ (Movement × Current)
reflected_sentence: In Vibrational Reality, the reach of Frequency shortens as Movement grows: the more Movement, the less Vibration extends.
rule_reason: A cost that falls with mass — reaching far gets harder as the mediator gets heavier — turns around: on the nonphysical side, more Movement means less reach.
interpretation: The cost turns around: what fell with mass now falls with Movement. Range reflects to Vibration as extent; the constant has no partner. The formula keeps its word-map image while the reading inverts.
closing: The rule decided on its own: one resistance-cost, turns around. The Planck constant has no partner, but that does not affect the shape call, only the completeness of the formula.
